bias_reference: Count two unique FLOAT bias planes once,3072B. Actual source loads both once per active program; no claim that unique-value references equal physical traffic.
boundary: TopK input logits/IDs, unique biases, materialized weights/IDs and template reference only. Router GEMM/ID preparation, allocation, helper packing, launches/events, state publication and cache generation are excluded and must be priced.

fixed_row_loop_model.claim: Removing16 rows reduces total work but does not reduce the maximum17-row loop count with48 programs. This fixed homogeneous-row scheduling reference is not a universal latency lower bound or proof of no benefit.

theory.legal_graph: Constant padding removes any necessity for per-use nonlinear/sort on those rows if exact result reuse is permitted. Fresh full raw-output materialization remains in this domain.
theory.bound: For a declared legal graph and genuinely necessary resource work Q_r with capacity upper bounds C_r, T>=max_r(Q_r/C_r). Under a fresh dense raw-output store interface requiring every byte, Q_output_store>=8Pk; do not identify this with HBM without a hierarchy/initial-state proof.
